Barraza26LaborComposition.compositionCon.display:
∀ (laborCost : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (V ellF ellI : ℝ → ℝ) (a d aLower Hbar RF RI psiF psiI phiF phiI : ℝ),
  Barraza26LaborComposition.comparisonIndividualCondition a aLower RF RI →
    Barraza26LaborComposition.laborPreferencesCondition laborCost psiF psiI phiF phiI →
      Barraza26LaborComposition.interiorRegularBranchCondition V ellF ellI a d Hbar RF RI psiF psiI phiF phiI →
        have sI : ℝ → ℝ := Barraza26LaborComposition.informalHoursShare ellF ellI;
        HasDerivAt sI (sI a * (1 - sI a) * (phiI - phiF) * d / V a) a ∧
          (Barraza26LaborComposition.localConcavityCondition d →
            (phiF < phiI → deriv sI a < 0) ∧ (phiI = phiF → deriv sI a = 0) ∧ (phiI < phiF → 0 < deriv sI a))

Barraza26LaborComposition.interiorRegula.display:
type:
(ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop

value:
fun (V ellF ellI : ℝ → ℝ) (a d Hbar RF RI psiF psiI phiF phiI : ℝ) =>
  HasDerivAt V d a ∧
    0 < V a ∧
      ∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in nhds a,
        0 < ellF x ∧
          0 < ellI x ∧
            ellF x + ellI x < Hbar ∧
              V x * RF - psiF * ellF x ^ (1 / phiF) = 0 ∧ V x * RI - psiI * ellI x ^ (1 / phiI) = 0

Barraza26LaborComposition.laborPreferenc.display:
type:
(ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → Prop

value:
fun (laborCost : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (psiF psiI phiF phiI : ℝ) =>
  0 < psiF ∧
    0 < psiI ∧
      0 < phiF ∧
        0 < phiI ∧
          ∀ (ellF ellI : ℝ),
            0 ≤ ellF →
              0 ≤ ellI →
                laborCost ellF ellI =
                  psiF * ellF ^ (1 + 1 / phiF) / (1 + 1 / phiF) + psiI * ellI ^ (1 + 1 / phiI) / (1 + 1 / phiI)
